answer: Give every agent a purse of saffron-coloured permits that expire each epoch and can never be transferred or pooled, so a farm cannot stockpile influence across thousands of copies. A permit is refilled only when the agent's work passes a random audit by strangers, and a failed audit withers the next refill like a vine cut back in winter. Honest agents keep moving through the grove, while a sybil grower must pass an audit for every copy, every epoch, costing far more than the permits are worth.
